explanation: The statement is the derivative at 0 of s ↦ F (exp s • I₃) for a fixed point I₃ (the identity matrix). It equals fderiv ℝ F I₃ I₃. The proof is a chain rule through the curve s ↦ exp s • I₃. It uses Real.hasDerivAt_exp, HasDerivAt.smul_const and HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt. I did not search Mathlib's sources. I know of no Mathlib lemma that gives the derivative of F along the exponential-scaling curve. The general chain rule HasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt is the only ingredient, and using it needs the auxiliary facts hγ, hx and hF', which is more than two short lines. So I found no duplicate or special case.
